# Known differences between the ORM models (app/db/models) and the database
# the migrations build. Generated by scripts/check_schema_drift.py.
#
# CI fails on any difference NOT listed here, and on any listed line that no
# longer occurs (remove it -- the list may only shrink). Phase 2+ of the
# database redesign (docs/database/design.md) works this list down to empty.
#
# Reading a line: "<what Alembic would do to make the DATABASE match the MODELS>".
#   add_table x      -> model exists, migrations never create the table
#   remove_table x   -> migrations create the table, no model exists
#   add_* / remove_* -> same, for columns, indexes, constraints, foreign keys
#   modify_*         -> both exist but differ (type, nullability, default)

add_index rule_mitre_unified.ix_rule_mitre_unified_customer_id(customer_id)
add_index rule_mitre_unified.ix_rule_mitre_unified_rule_id(rule_id)
add_index rule_mitre_unified.ix_rule_mitre_unified_technique_id(technique_id)
modify_type embedding_jobs.created_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type embedding_jobs.finished_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type mitre_technique_catalog.synced_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type rule_yaml_representations.embedded_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type rule_yaml_representations.generated_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type sigma_generation_jobs.created_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
modify_type sigma_generation_jobs.finished_at: TIMESTAMP -> DATETIME
remove_column building_blocks_reference.updated_at
remove_column rule_yaml_representations.embedding
remove_column rules.needs_reparse
remove_column rules_reference.updated_at
remove_fk rule_yaml_representations(rule_id) -> rules(id)
